The workbook generation failed to populate critical data cells, resulting in 'None' values across the 'Task' worksheet.
The test_legacy_pytest_suite failed with an AssertionError because multiple cell ranges (H12:L17 and H35:L40) contained None instead of the expected numeric metrics. Specifically, test_lookup_blocks reported 'top block mismatches' (e.g., H12: expected 612.5, got None) and test_derived_values_and_stats reported 'net metric mismatches' (e.g., H35: expected 4.499..., got None). While the workbook structure was created, the logic for calculating or writing these weighted bedflow values to the 'Task' sheet is missing or failing to execute.
